theorem QOU.KZ.KZHexagon.hexagon {R : Type u_1} [NormedRing R] [NormedAlgebra ℂ R] [CompleteSpace R] (A B : R) (hA : ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → Function.Injective (FuchsianFormal.indicial A k)) (hB : ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → Function.Injective (FuchsianFormal.indicial B k)) (hC : ∀ (k : ℕ), 0 < k → Function.Injective (FuchsianFormal.indicial (-A - B) k)) (H₀ H₁ K₀ K₁ L₀ L₁ : ℕ → R) (h₀ : H₀ 0 = 1) (hH₀ : FuchsianFormal.IsFormalGauge (FuchsianFormal.kzM0 A B) H₀) (h₁ : H₁ 0 = 1) (hH₁ : FuchsianFormal.IsFormalGauge (FuchsianFormal.kzM0 B A) H₁) (k₀ : K₀ 0 = 1) (hK₀ : FuchsianFormal.IsFormalGauge (FuchsianFormal.kzM0 B (-A - B)) K₀) (k₁ : K₁ 0 = 1) (hK₁ : FuchsianFormal.IsFormalGauge (FuchsianFormal.kzM0 (-A - B) B) K₁) (l₀ : L₀ 0 = 1) (hL₀ : FuchsianFormal.IsFormalGauge (FuchsianFormal.kzM0 (-A - B) A) L₀) (l₁ : L₁ 0 = 1) (hL₁ : FuchsianFormal.IsFormalGauge (FuchsianFormal.kzM0 A (-A - B)) L₁) :
